definitions.explanation: a traditional wooden container used to store cooked rice and keep it warm

examples.japanese: おひつ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{移|うつ}す→移す：10122_utsusu⟧。
examples.english: To transfer rice to the ohitsu.

examples.japanese: おひつ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧べたつかない。
examples.english: Using an ohitsu prevents the rice from becoming sticky.

examples.japanese: ⟦{老舗|しにせ}→老舗：16152_shinise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料亭|りょうてい}→料亭：21710_ryoutei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧おひつ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}てくる→出てくる：29121_detekuru⟧。
examples.english: At traditional high-end restaurants, rice is served in an ohitsu.

notes:
おひつ (also written {御櫃|おひつ}) is a traditional wooden container for storing cooked rice after it leaves the ⟦{炊飯器|すいはんき}→炊飯器：04972_suihanki⟧ or pot. The wood absorbs excess moisture, keeping rice at an ideal texture — neither too wet nor too dry.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Traditionally made from ⟦{檜|ひのき}→檜：04402_hinoki⟧ (Japanese cypress) or ⟦{杉|すぎ}→杉：03889_sugi⟧ (cedar). Still used in traditional ⟦{料亭|りょうてい}→料亭：21710_ryoutei⟧ (high-end Japanese restaurants) and ⟦{寿司屋|すしや}→寿司屋：10166_sushiya⟧ (sushi shops). Some households use them for everyday rice storage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- おひつ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{移|うつ}す→移す：10122_utsusu⟧: to transfer (rice) to the ohitsu
- おひつ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to serve in an ohitsu

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{寿司桶|すしおけ}→寿司桶：08131_sushioke⟧: sushi rice tub (wider, shallower)
- {飯台|はんだい}: wooden rice tub
